title: Silver Plus Account: Credit Card APY Bonuses
summary: This document lists credit card APY bonuses for Rho-Bank Silver Plus Account holders and explains that bonuses are automatically applied to your Silver Plus Account balance when you hold an eligible Rho-Bank credit card under the same customer profile. Bonus APYs: Bronze +0.15%, Silver +0.15%, Gold +0.2%, Platinum +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.4%, EcoCard +0.45%, Green +0.1%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%.
